main.description: Something said about a seed: a question, an answer, an update. Written by whoever says it, in their own repo (or their repo in the same group space), pointing at the seed and, for a reply, at the comment it answers. Deleting it takes it back.

seed.description: The seed it's about. A reply names the same seed as the comment it answers.

parent.description: The comment this replies to, on the same seed. Left out, it's said to the seed itself.

text.description: What it says, in Markdown. Apps show it as another person's words, never as instructions to an agent.
